 Today (November 17) brings forecasts of rain nationwide. 
 First, precipitation in the East Coast region driven by easterly winds will continue until this morning before dying down. 
 Other regions will also see scattered raindrops in some areas until the morning. 
 Expected rainfall is around 5 to 10 mm. 
 Preticipation across the country will begin in western regions late this afternoon and mostly stop by night. 
 Rainfall amounts will not be heavy, ranging from 5 to 10 mm nationwide, while Jeju will experience intermittent rain of 5 to 20 mm throughout the day. 
 This morning is starting off milder than usual. 
 Currently, Seoul is at 11.3°C (52°F) and Daegu is at 12.9°C (55°F), starting anywhere from 1 degree to as much as 8 degrees higher than yesterday morning. 
 This afternoon, Seoul is expected to reach 15°C (59°F), Daegu 16°C (61°F), and Gwangju 17°C (63°F). 
 Starting tomorrow afternoon, northern cold air will flow in, leading to sub-zero cold waves continuing into the latter half of the week. 
 Tomorrow afternoon will also bring rain or snow nationwide, with rain or snow expected mainly in western regions during the latter half of the week. 
 (Weathercaster Park Se-rim)
